tips.text: Aim for at least 400 grams of fruits and vegetables a day, about five portions, to lower your risk of diet-related diseases.
Keep salt below 5 grams a day, about one level teaspoon, counting the salt already in sauces, instant noodles and processed food.
Limit free sugars (added sugar, syrups, sweetened drinks and juices) to less than 10% of your daily energy intake.
Adults should get at least 150 minutes of moderate-intensity physical activity a week, and cut down on time spent sitting.
Cover, empty and clean water containers around your home every week, so dengue mosquitoes have nowhere to breed.
tips.source: World Health Organization: Dengue and severe dengue

tips.text: Dengue mosquitoes bite during the day: wear clothes that cover your arms and legs and use a repellent with DEET, picaridin or IR3535.
tips.source: World Health Organization: Dengue and severe dengue
